entities.summary: Fernando Rodney is a Dominican-American professional baseball pitcher for the Hamilton Cardinals of the Canadian Baseball League (CBL). He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Detroit Tigers, Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim, Tampa Bay Rays, Seattle Mariners, Chicago Cubs, San Diego Padres, Miami Marlins, Arizona Diamondbacks, Minnesota Twins, Oakland Athletics, and Washington Nationals.
